'''Forward Air Control''' (FAC) was a part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and, later, the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]]. FAC was present and in control of all [[Realspace/Legends|space]] units at the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. A member of FAC ordered [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|RC-1138]] and [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], minus [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], to pull out. Those orders came directly from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and were to be followed through without disobedience. FAC were finally able to get the remaining Delta's to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for their next assignment. The FAC would later be incorporated into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] air control.

In the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], during [[Blockade of Corellia]], FAC coordinated Galactic Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] activity patrolling space around [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
